accordion.standaloneDescription: A single collapsible item with its own hover state.
accordion.singleExpandDescription: Multiple items with proximity hover — only one can be expanded at a time.
accordion.multiExpandDescription: Multiple items with proximity hover — several can be expanded at once.
accordion.rootType: Whether one or multiple items can be expanded.
accordion.rootCollapsible: Allow collapsing all items when type is single.
accordion.itemIndex: Position index for proximity hover. Required inside AccordionGroup, omit for standalone.
